description: GHOST MIX: sums the twelve voices of the Ghost kit, plus an outside signal, into one mix output at unity gain

params.text: Silences that channel while it is switched to muted

inputs.text: One voice of the kit, at whatever level its own module sends

outputs.text: The sum of every unmuted channel, clamped to stay within 10V either way

notes: the channels are summed at unity with no level control here, because each voice has its own level knob
the channel marked MIXIN is the 909's external mix-in, for a signal from outside the kit or a voice chained in
